title: R100-SL dwelling fronts a primary street, secondary street or public right-of-way
text: Housing on lots less than 100m2 – applies to single houses and grouped dwellings in areas coded R100-SL only. C2.10.1 Single houses in areas coded R100-SL are to comply with the following: i. dwellings to front a primary street, secondary street, or public right-of-way; and

notes: Element heading: 'applies to single houses and grouped dwellings in areas coded R100-SL only'. The lot-under-100m2 condition comes from the element title; the clause body names only the coding. Verify whether an R100-SL lot of 100m2 or more is caught.

verified.note: Ambiguous on the page: the element sub-heading (p24) reads 'Housing on lots less than 100m2 – applies to single houses and grouped dwellings in areas coded R100-SL only', while C2.10.1 names only the R100-SL coding; whether an R100-SL lot of 100m2 or more is caught is not stated.
